rationale: The concessive “Ngay cả khi chọn kích thước đầu ra nhỏ nhất” correctly conditions the remaining decoder-memory requirement on minimum output dimensions. It removes the current implication that the output itself must contain the decoder buffers. The main clause places the limit on current memory, not storage space or file size, and retains the instruction to cancel and use a smaller source image. ImageResizeDialog constructs this message when native work is present and a 1×1 output is still inadmissible; ImageImport explains that source/tile decode work need not shrink with output.
